components.name: Tempered Glass Cover
components.reasoning: The tempered glass is the front protective layer ensuring durability and light transmission, standard in virtually all PV modules.

components.name: Aluminum Frame
components.reasoning: Provides structural integrity and mounting interface, widely used though some designs like frameless modules exist.

components.name: Encapsulation Material (EVA or POE)
components.reasoning: Encapsulates and bonds solar cells to the glass and backsheet, protecting against moisture and mechanical damage; typically procured separately.

components.name: Backsheet
components.reasoning: Protective rear layer offering electrical insulation and environmental protection; a standardized component often purchased independently.

components.name: Junction Box
components.reasoning: Houses electrical connections and bypass diodes, essential for module performance and safety with its own separate supply chain.

components.name: Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells

components.name: Tempered Glass Cover

components.name: Aluminum Frame

components.name: Polymer Encapsulation Layer (EVA or POE)
components.reasoning: Encapsulant sheets protect and bond solar cells within the module; these polymer films are procured as manufactured components before lamination.

components.name: Backsheet

components.name: Junction Box with Bypass Diodes
components.reasoning: Electrically critical component attached on the rear of the module; houses connection terminals and bypass diodes and is procured as a separate assembly.

components.name: Module Interconnect Wires and Connectors
components.reasoning: Includes pre-manufactured cables and standard MC4 connectors for field electrical connection; while sometimes integrated, they are often separately sourced components.

Solar Cell.name: Silicon
Solar Cell.reasoning: Primary semiconductor material for photovoltaic conversion in solar cells; absolutely essential and widely used with almost no substitutes.

Solar Cell.name: Silver
Solar Cell.reasoning: Used for front contact metallization to collect current; industry standard though copper is an emerging alternative.

Solar Cell.name: Aluminum
Solar Cell.reasoning: Commonly used for back contact and frame structures in solar cells; universally accepted material due to light weight and conductivity.

Solar Cell.name: Phosphorus
Solar Cell.reasoning: Used as an n-type dopant in silicon to form the PN junction; standard in the industry though arsenic can be an alternative.

Solar Cell.name: Boron
Solar Cell.reasoning: Used as a p-type dopant in silicon to create the PN junction; standard practice though gallium dopants are possible alternatives.

Glass Cover.name: Borosilicate glass
Glass Cover.reasoning: Used as the protective transparent cover in solar panels due to its thermal stability and durability; industry standard for quality solar covers.

Glass Cover.name: Glass
Glass Cover.reasoning: General glass materials may be used for cover in less demanding solar panels; provides optical clarity and weather resistance.

Chassis Assembly.name: Aluminum
Chassis Assembly.reasoning: Widely used metal for solar panel frames and chassis due to lightweight, corrosion resistance, and structural strength.

Chassis Assembly.name: Steel Ingots
Chassis Assembly.reasoning: Used in some chassis assemblies to provide additional mechanical strength; often stainless steel variants are used but base steel is fundamental.

Chassis Assembly.name: Stainless steel
Chassis Assembly.reasoning: Corrosion resistant alloy used in fasteners and reinforcement parts of chassis; standard in durable frames.

High-conductivity Cable.name: Copper
High-conductivity Cable.reasoning: Primary conductor material due to excellent electrical conductivity and reliability; almost universally used for electrical wiring in solar systems.

High-conductivity Cable.name: Aluminum
High-conductivity Cable.reasoning: Occasionally used as a lighter and cheaper conductor alternative to copper but with lower conductivity; less common in high-quality cables.
